HOW TO PLAY
THE VEILBREAKER · COMBAT COMPENDIUM
⚡ Movement
A/D·L.Stick
Move left & right
SPACE·A
Jump — press again mid-air for double jump
⚔ Combat
LMB·X
Attack — chain attacks to build towards the combo meter to receive rewards
Q·Y
Special — weapon-specific power move
F·RT
Launch — Tap to send enemies airborne
🛡 Defense
RMB·LB
Deflect — tap to parry an attack at the exact moment of impact and build towards enemy stun meter
⇧·B
Evade — quick dash with brief invincibility frames
✨ Skills
R·LT
Magic — cast your equipped spell.
E·RB
Grapple — Tap to fetch/targeted enemy; hold to zip towards them.
⬆ Advanced Techniques
Air Dash

EVADE/DASH while airborne for to perform a mid-air dash to avoid damage and close in on enemies.

Air Slam

Hold LAUNCH in the air to crash enemy straight down, stunning them.

Juggle Follow

After launching an enemy into the air, JUMP to follow them up and extend the combo.

Reflect Projectiles

Perfectly timing a DEFLECT against a projectile sends it back at the enemy.

Air Teleport

Hold DEFLECT while airborne instantly snap to the floor — great for escaping pressure.

🔥 Elemental System
WEAPON
Attacking builds your weapon's elemental gauge
MAGIC
Casting spells charges a second elemental gauge
BURST
Fill the bar completely to trigger element-specific effects
